title: The Albie Snow roman a clef
summary: Shaw says his current novel looks like Artie Shaw and draws on his and others' experiences.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: The book you’re . . . the project you’re on at the moment, this book about Albie Snow, is it?
Yeah, Albie Snow, if you look at it fast, looks like Artie Shaw. It’s a roman à clé.
A lot of this is obviously based on experiences that you had yourself?
Mine and others. The nice thing about the fiction is that I can draw on any source I know about.
